math-sequences-limits.alt: Two plots of terms against n for n = 1 to 12, one dot per term. Left: a sub n = 1 + (−1) to the n over n; the dots alternate above and below the dashed line at height 1 and close in on it, so the sequence converges to 1. Right: b sub n = (−1) to the n times n over (n + 1); the dots jump between values near 1 and near −1 and never settle, so the sequence diverges.
